production_source_comparison.interpretation: Application inputs match the successful Linux/CLI matrix commit. All application jobs use one source commit; research source hashes match the successful REA study. Eight local user extensions are retained.

limits: No real hardware setting or telemetry measurement was verified.
Shimada presence-query mapping is restricted to family 1Ah/model 08h, PCI 1022:153a/BDF 0 and SMU 115.46.0. It maps presence-mask order to firmware target IDs, not OS CPUs/APICs or active cores.

Five core rows and three CCD rows have static reference unit evidence: voltage model, temperature, residency percentages and interval counter ratio. Other units, residency state labels, PM physical mapping and live sensor validity remain unresolved; runtime 61h stays denied.

Granite Ridge native capture is restricted to family 1Ah/model 44h, PCI 1022:14d8/BDF 0, SMU 98.84.0 and exact table 620105/1828 or 620205/2452. Unit interpretation is based on the pinned reference; capture firmware provenance and PM physical mapping remain unverified. The two-slot table optionally maps firmware IDs [0,1] through the pinned initializer; one-slot tables remain ambiguous. CPUID L3 identification is separate from these firmware IDs.

An indexed-code consumer slice feeds a shared floor; independent second-rail physical identity, encoded hardware-request consumption and readback remain unverified. Other firmware/tuning and previously documented remaining features are incomplete.
EL7 means Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64. Windows/macOS validate the portable core, not a complete application port.
QEMU verifies module integration only; actual register settings and Secure Boot were not tested.

svi_register_mailbox.read_reply: byte from completed hardware reply bits 15:8

temperature.invalid_sensor_behavior: previous converted value retained; per-core maximum may reuse it

interval_ratio.numerator: accumulated ticks plus active interval if flagged

unit_proof.residency_labels: C0/CC1/CC6 remain candidate names; fraction-to-percent scaling is traced

topology_proof.mapping: ascending set bits of presence mask; core availability does not compact storage rank
topology_proof.two_slot_consequence: within this two-target firmware, width 2 implies storage IDs [0,1]
topology_proof.one_slot_ambiguity: width 1 can mean target 0 or target 1 without the presence mask

limitations: Static discovery is not a proof that every function has been recovered; only byte-checked slices are used.

Five core and three CCD rows have static unit evidence. Voltage model is not measured rail voltage; conditional sensors may retain old values; interval ratio is not confirmed CPU utilization. Other units and physical identities remain unresolved.
Firmware two-slot IDs [0,1] do not establish CPUID CCD/APIC or physical core/OS CPU association. One-slot native mapping remains ambiguous.
61h indexed storage and shared-floor selection do not establish independently addressable rails or a second-rail getter.
Reciprocal accuracy, floating exception behavior, encoded hardware requests and peripheral effects were not emulated.
Synthetic replay does not establish live timing, freshness, atomicity or target-machine acceptance. ASUS 2503 is a reference, not the installed BIOS.
